review_type: External Claude Code Opus 5.5 review plus separate Codex statistical, Sanskrit, visual and publication reviews
scope: Post-outcome refinements. External hand counts were checked against the pinned reading-order input before integration.

decisions.issue: W158 exclusion used final position alone
decisions.decision: Accepted: regroup W154/W156/W158 as a qualified-carrier complex. W154/W158 closing blocks are 31/32 and 18/19; descriptive Fisher is 1.0. W806 formula differences keep subtypes open.

decisions.issue: Substitution summaries omitted W527/W617 and the main jar alternative
decisions.decision: Accepted: publish aggregate template lengths and every substitute for all ten reviewed codes. W740 substitutes for W151 in 8/16 templates.

decisions.issue: Two-sign and partner structure can generate final enrichment
decisions.decision: Accepted in part: report length>=3 analytic effects, narrow-stroke adjacency and formula clusters. Defer a fitted joint ordering model until its estimation/evaluation design is declared; present sensitivities expose but do not remove partner confounding.
Corrected: W156 follows the declared stroke class in 9/34, rather than 8/34. Three W130/W035 contexts begin with W171, rather than ending with it. Original external review remains unchanged.

decisions.issue: Literal queries ignored Sanskrit joins and lacked comparative residual ranks
decisions.decision: Accepted: verify samvaha/saaṃśa literal absence separately from attested saṃvāha/sāṃśa. Apply the same finite joins to every rival and expose crosswalk exclusions. Literal sam is tied at rank2; joined rank11. Avoid the stronger unsupported claim that no residual ever stands out.

Accepted as a stress test: publish alternative stems, both component orders and 1000 same-length controls for bhārin/varga/dvāra/kṛṣi/lāṅgala. They are semantic comparisons with no asserted new phonetic windows.

decisions.issue: Public class drawings hide carrier variant strokes
decisions.decision: Modified remedy: explicitly state that W154/W156/W158 share a representative P004/V145 drawing, describe locally observed distinctions and preserve exact font witnesses locally. Do not substitute newly drawn exact-variant claims without artifact concordance. Enlarge licensed crops and label the W617 schematic not to cell count.
Accepted: add a related closing-design rival. Component resemblance does not establish derivation or interchangeability.

decisions.issue: W617 segmentation dominates a single-word proposal
decisions.decision: Accepted: move W617 to a pictorial/segmentation lead, recode it as two abstract grid tokens for analytic sensitivity, retain the pair-as-block reference and the animal-scene standard resemblance as alternatives.

decisions.issue: Estimated permutation moments and site enumeration
decisions.decision: Accepted: reuse saved draws with fixed analytic moments, disclose1388 active/400 deterministic comparisons, and add29 code/site summaries. W142 medial maximum p is0.461108; final avoidance is1/39, analytic z -3.618.

decisions.issue: Protocol named17 anchor codes while BH covered596x3
decisions.decision: Accepted: disclose the larger family and separate site sensitivity in a post-review amendment. Keep the broad reference rather than selecting a new count threshold to favour a result.
Accepted: describe it as family reweighting with repeated formula/mould dependence; publish preceding-pair cluster counts as descriptive groups, not independent effective sample sizes.

Accepted: correct adhikārin/kṛṣaka/gopāla, distinguish koṣṭha enclosure from granary, add verified vivadha/matya/kaṅkata and yuga/kośa/śreṇi. Later bhāra/kumbha measure senses remain rivals without imported unit values.

decisions.issue: Reproducibility, source notices and misleading examples
decisions.decision: Accepted: hash diagnostic files and the saved local permutation file, use separate future lexical RNG and portable font fallback, add Lipi rights metadata, add W158 and genuinely medial W142 examples, and count unique objects explicitly.

decisions.issue: Public checkout navigation accepted local files
decisions.decision: Accepted: use Git-selected availability and a reviewed exact63-path omission register, add archived-link context, include two inspected authored HTML pages and verify an empty clone before changing visibility.
